DP

Six academic subjects across a range of areas, plus three core components.

LEVELS · SL AND HL

Choose a course and a level

SL means Standard Level. HL means Higher Level.

Two decisions
Course→Level

Language A / B ≠ SL / HL
Mathematics AA / AI ≠ SL / HL

HIGHER LEVEL

HL

More breadth and depth, with more teaching time.

STANDARD LEVEL

SL

A substantial course with a smaller scope than HL.

Your plan

DP: normally three HL and three SL. CP: DP subjects may be SL or HL.

HLHLHLSLSLSL
Usual DP pattern
Remember

The numbered SISJ selection blocks organise our timetable. They are not the IB subject-group numbers.

DP · THE CORE

More than six subjects

All DP students complete these three core components.

Six academic subjects+Three core components
TOK

Theory of Knowledge

Question claims and evidence: how do we know what we know?

EE

Extended Essay

Investigate a focused question through independent research.

CAS

Creativity, Activity, Service

Take part in creative, physical and service experiences, then reflect.

Remember

The core runs alongside your subjects across the two years. Make room for it in your plan.

CP · THE CORE

Four connected core components

CP students complete these alongside their DP subjects and career-related study.

DP subjects+CP core+Career-related study
PPS

Personal and Professional Skills

Develop communication, self-management and ethical thinking.

LCS

Language and Cultural Studies

Explore your languages, cultures and connections with others.

CE

Community Engagement

Learn with communities and respond to issues that matter.

RP

Reflective Project

Research and evaluate an ethical issue linked to a career-related interest.

Remember

The core is part of the full programme; it is not an optional extra.

THE WORK · BOTH PROGRAMMES

Plan for steady work

Subjects, projects and core work need attention across the two years.

01 / Regular practice

Learn regularly

Make time to read, practise, investigate and review feedback.

02 / Small, planned steps

Manage projects

Break longer tasks into steps and keep track of deadlines.

03 / Timely support

Ask early

Tell your teachers when you are unsure or need support.

Remember

Your DP subjects include assessed work during the course and examinations. CP also includes its own core and career-related work.
